senses.gloss:
दृंहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grown, increased.
 E. दृहि to increase, क्त affix.

दृन्भू m. (-न्भूः)
 1. The thunderbolt.
 2. The sun.
 f. (-न्भूः)
 1. A snake in
general.
 2. A wheel.
 E. दृभ् to fear, Uṇādi affix कू, क्विप् and नुम्
inserted; न being optionally changed to म, before भ, the word is
also read दृम्भू ।
